question: What factor determines which overridden instance method executes when invoked on a polymorphic reference?

options.text: The visibility modifier attached to private methods in the superclass.
The actual class of the underlying runtime object on the heap.
Whether the overridden method accesses static or dynamic fields.
The declared compile-time type of the reference variable.

explanation: Dynamic method dispatch resolves overridden instance methods at runtime based on the actual class of the object instantiated on the heap, not the reference type.

question: Do instance variables (fields) participate in dynamic method dispatch in Java?

options.text: No, fields are resolved at compile time based strictly on the reference type.
Yes, fields are dispatched dynamically according to the runtime object's class.
Yes, but only if the fields are declared with public visibility.
Yes, provided the subclass overrides the fields with identical types.

explanation: Fields in Java are not polymorphic and are never dispatched dynamically. Field accesses are resolved statically at compile time using the declared reference type.
